description: This file defines functions for interacting with a backend API, including GET and POST requests, and specific functions for fetching 'work items' and creating new ones. It also contains utility functions for URL building.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error with message.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters; handles response parsing and error handling.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items from backend, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item (task or bug) with specified attributes, following backend API specification.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Returns the full URL for a given API request path.

ctags.name: createWorkItem
ctags.pattern: /^export async function createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priori/
ctags.signature: ({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
